No update notes are included in this build.
See what changed after an update. You can reopen update history any time in Settings → About.
Keep command snippets above the keyboard, or use the swipe layout. Change this in Settings → Snippets; tap ✎ to manage snippets, then tap a snippet to edit it.
Compact session tabs leave more room for terminal content.
Herdr navigation menus work more reliably after resizing and in buffered input mode.
Open web pages and your code-server editor inside the workspace. Browser addresses and desktop layout are remembered; code-server passwords can be saved on this device.
Explore the quick-start guide and short demonstrations. Reopen it from Settings → User guide.
Local Arch Linux supports shared Unix sockets and large terminal input. You can optionally allow local agents to manage selected settings from Settings → Local Arch Linux.
Compare all, staged, unstaged or branch changes in the project reader.
Attach files to remote and local terminals. Long-press the attachment key to choose any file; multiple transfers preserve your selection order.
Edit or delete snippets from the snippet picker, and show or hide pinned snippets from the keyboard toolbar.
Herdr history handles delayed snapshots, redraws and narrow screens more reliably.
Keyboard Send handles newly typed or dictated buffered input more reliably.
